channel.title: Capture Verification Updates
channel.description: Most recent updates for Capture Verification

item.title: Version 4.2
item.description:
Capture Verification 4.2

Updating from 3.8? You will be asked to register once when you first open this version. It takes a few seconds, happens on this machine only, and does not need a network connection — on a closed set, fill the form in and carry on; your details are sent automatically the next time you are online. The trial expiry that 3.8 carried is gone.

Fixed: variants not detected until Capture One rewrote its sidecars

Capture One records a new variant in the session database immediately but rewrites the image's sidecar file only later — on an adjustment, on quit, or on its own schedule. Verification only read the sidecars, so a session where every image had just been cloned showed no variants at all. Variant counts now come from the session database, with the sidecars as a fallback, so a cloned-but-unprocessed variant is reported as unprocessed straight away.

Fixed: shots rendered to two formats failed

A shot processed to a JPG recipe and a TIFF recipe — into one folder, or into separate JPG/ and TIFF/ recipe folders — was reported as duplicate renders and failed. Both layouts now pass and the folder row and the PDF show both counts, e.g. “19 JPG · 19 TIF”, with the size of both included.

Changed: files found inside the Capture folder

Processed files inside Capture (a RAW+JPEG tether, or a stray export) were moved to Trash/quarantine silently on every scan. You are now asked: leave them in place, in which case the report notes them and the session can still pass, or move them to quarantine, which is recorded as a failure.

Backup verification

  • A backup copy that is a different size from the master is a mismatch, not a match.
  • A drive that cannot be read, or has no Capture folder, says so instead of showing 0%.
  • RAW files directly in the Capture folder are compared, not only those in subfolders.
  • Re-Verify keeps the drive results on screen and in the PDF.
  • Two backups on the same volume are told apart by the folder that holds them.

Matching

  • Output folders named with a different separator or Capture One's counter suffix (Shot_01 for Shot-01, SHOT01_02 for SHOT01) are matched.
  • More RAW formats are recognised: IIQ, 3FR, FFF, MOS, MEF, NRW, RWL, CRW, ERF, SR2.
  • Additional output formats (WebP, AVIF, …) can be added under Settings → Advanced.
  • RAW files directly in the Capture folder are verified as “(Capture Root)”.
  • An empty capture folder is listed as empty, not failed.
  • A Capture folder with no captures, or a session without an Output folder, shows a clear message instead of the previous session's results.

Results and reports

  • Files marked intentional survive Done and Re-Verify; the verdict updates to PASS.
  • The PDF lists intentionally excluded files, files moved to quarantine, and files left in place inside Capture; dismissed naming warnings are left out; the camera and lens toggles in Settings now actually remove those sections.
  • Naming warnings no longer flag a copy or duplicate a second time as a pattern break.
  • Scanning runs in the background, so the window stays responsive on large sessions.
  • Settings and the Verification Options sheet fit smaller windows; the options sheet has a Cancel button; folder exclusions and backup drives no longer carry over to the next session.
